name: StegVerse NS Ecosystem
definition: A genuine continuity-bearing node of the sovereign StegVerse ecosystem, not merely an installed runtime or isolated sovereign deployment.
activation_rule: NODE_SOVEREIGN_ACTIVE only when every required_activation_capability is evidenced and no fail_closed_condition is present.

node_identity.description: A portable-node continuity identity distinct from provider accounts and transport endpoints.

local_continuity_state.description: User/node-controlled continuity vault or equivalent state capable of preserving identity, policy/evidence references, receipts, recovery material, and prior-state linkage.

continuity_envelope.description: A shared continuity envelope or compatible representation binding object/event identity, hashes, prior receipt linkage, custody/disclosure posture, profile references, and signatures where applicable.

artifact_event_receipts.description: Receipt-bearing capture/observation and governed transition records with replay or reconstruction pointers.

peer_exchange.description: At least one governed node-to-node exchange path over a transport-independent protocol boundary.

independent_receiver_admission.description: Receiver performs its own admission; sender admission never becomes receiver authority automatically.

authority_monotonicity.description: Downstream authority may narrow but never silently broaden beyond admitted upstream authority.

membership_proof.description: Inspectably proves this deployment is admitted as a genuine sovereign-ecosystem node rather than merely self-declaring NS status.

anti_sybil_standing.description: Node membership/contribution standing is resistant to fake-node creation and self-corroboration through controlled identities.

recovery_reconstruction.description: Node identity/state and governed history can be recovered or reconstructed from preserved evidence without equating reconstruction alone with continuity.

selective_participation.description: User/node controls whether artifacts remain local or participate in bounded network sharing/corroboration, with minimum necessary disclosure.

governed_execution_boundary.description: Consequential transitions remain StegGate-governed; node membership, uptime, transport availability, model confidence, or process persistence do not create execution authority.

least_stable_capability_runtime.description: Execution uses capability minimization and least-stable viable micro-node construction with ephemeral-by-default behavior where viable.

contribution_receipts.description: Useful network contribution can be attributed through receipts without allowing economic value to purchase governance authority.
